scope: Evidence review before any Home Village Super Valkyrie death Rage behavior is enabled.

sources.title: Super Valkyrie Is All The RAGE!
sources.finding: Official video description establishes that a Rage Spell is dropped on destruction for other friendly units.

sources.title: Balance Changes Now Live
sources.finding: Official balance note changes attack speed to 1.1 seconds, movement speed to 3 tiles/second and Rage radius to 4 tiles.

sources.title: Super Valkyrie | Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.finding: Community summary characterizes the death effect as Rage-like, smaller and shorter than a normal Rage Spell, but supplies no immutable build or complete effect contract.

established: The death-triggered friendly Rage effect is primary-confirmed.
Its current radius is primary-confirmed as 4 tiles.
unresolved: No official source specifies effect duration, Rage level, damage and attack-speed multipliers, application cadence, or overlap/stacking semantics.
No source specifies exact death-tick ordering versus death damage, target selection, projectile effects, spells, or a unit entering/leaving the radius.
No source verifies collision/overlay geometry, sprite placement or visual timing.
decision: Do not enable super_valkyrie in Core, GUI or RL until a version-identified death-Rage duration and multiplier contract is available. A generic normal Rage effect would invent future-affecting values.
